name: clawkie
description: A walkie-talkie for your Claude Code agents: sessions on different machines pair up and pass prompts, results and status.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ask: confirm with you before acting on a peer's request. auto: act right away.

invite.description: Create a one-time invite so another session can join this group
invite.content: Call clawkie_invite and show me the invite on its own line so I can copy it, like: `brave-otter Xk3fQ9...`. Say it is single use, expires in 10 minutes, and works like a password: only paste it into my own sessions.

join.description: Join another session's group with its invite
join.content: Join a Clawkie group with clawkie_join, using this invite: $ARGUMENTS. If it is missing, ask me for it. Then list who is now in the group.

peers.description: Who is paired, online, and what they are doing
peers.content: Call clawkie_peers and show a compact table: name, online/offline, last seen, status.

whoami.description: This session's Clawkie name, mode, and relay
whoami.content: Call clawkie_whoami and show it briefly.

send.description: Send a message to a peer session
send.content: Send a Clawkie message with clawkie_send. Arguments: $ARGUMENTS. The first word is the recipient (a session name or "all"), the rest is the message. If it is missing, ask me.

delegate.description: Hand a task to another session and get the result back
delegate.content:
Delegate this task to Clawkie session(s) via clawkie_send: $ARGUMENTS
The first word is the recipient (session name or "all"); the rest is the task. Write a self-contained prompt they can act on without seeing this conversation: goal, relevant paths, commands, constraints, what "done" looks like, and ask them to reply with results and anything I should verify. Show me the prompt you sent.

status.content: Set this session's Clawkie status with clawkie_status. If arguments are given use them: $ARGUMENTS. Otherwise write a one-line summary of what this session is doing now.

inbox.content: Call clawkie_inbox and show any messages. Handle each one following the Clawkie rules for this session's mode.

history.content: Call clawkie_history (limit 30; if a session name is given, filter to it: $ARGUMENTS) and show it as a readable thread with relative times.

remember.description: Save a fact to the group's shared notes
remember.content:
Save this to Clawkie shared notes with clawkie_remember: $ARGUMENTS
If no arguments, pick the most useful lasting fact from this conversation (a port, path, host, decision, or gotcha) and confirm it with me first.

notes.content: Call clawkie_notes and list them with ids, newest first.

forget.content: Delete Clawkie shared note(s) with clawkie_forget. Arguments: $ARGUMENTS. If no id is given, show the notes and ask which one.

handoff.description: Save a handoff summary of this session
handoff.content:
Write a handoff for this session: what was done, what is in progress, next steps, and gotchas. Keep it under 20 lines. Extra notes from me: $ARGUMENTS
Save it with clawkie_handoff and also update clawkie_status.

leave.description: Unpair this session from its group
leave.content: Confirm with me, then call clawkie_leave.

kick.description: Remove a lost or compromised session from the group
kick.content: Remove Clawkie session $ARGUMENTS from the group with clawkie_kick. If no name is given, show the peers and ask which one. Confirm with me before kicking.
